assignment: Review GetShiftsHistoryAsync as next reporting callable: actual shift selection/order/cap, shared summary computation, route authorization, DTO/client, existing tests. Static source only; keep separate from canonical registries.

source.behavior: Queries all shifts AsNoTracking, orders by OpenedAtUtc descending, takes the requested number (default 90), materializes them, bulk-resolves opener/closer names, then computes one ShiftSummaryDto per selected shift by calling the same BuildShiftSummaryAsync used by the individual shift report. Shared helper scopes non-cancelled sales to ShiftId, identifies unsettled cash-on-delivery custody for collected-cash classification, sums expenses whose ShiftId matches, and copies persisted cash-close snapshot fields. No state changes.

cross_file_evidence.behavior: Individual shift endpoint and history share the exact sales/expense/cash summary builder, reducing formula drift between the views. The summary does not recompute close values. Prior bounded review found expenses total includes any shift-linked protected source, not drawer-only; that scope note applies here too.
GET /api/reports/shifts takes no caller-supplied take limit and invokes GetShiftsHistoryAsync with default 90; it is gated by RequireReportsAccessAsync because rows include sales/cash totals.

Client marks totals available only with reports_view; when permitted, LoadAsync calls current/single shift summary and history API, then replaces the History collection with returned rows. Without permission it shows history as restricted and does not call the report route.
Client history request wraps /api/reports/shifts and deserializes ShiftSummaryDto collection.
Each history item exposes shift identity/state, cash figures, SalesReportDto, ExpensesTotalPiastres, opener/closer names and timestamps/reason.

Tests assert an open shift appears with name/open time/opening cash/sales, a closed shift has distinct closer name/time, and a cashier without reports_view is refused. No test covers sorting/cap >90, expense-source semantics, or accounting invariants across many shifts. Test bodies were read; none executed.

assessment.financial_relevance: Manager-facing aggregate of shift-level sales, expenses and close snapshots; useful for reviewing historical drawer/shift operations but not itself a ledger or accounting calculation.
observations: Only most recent 90 shifts by OpenedAtUtc are returned by the route (the service supports take parameter but endpoint uses default). The source documents this as a scalability safeguard; older shifts remain persisted but are omitted from this bounded history screen. No source contract indicates this is an exhaustive accounting archive.

All returned summaries reuse the single-shift builder, so current report semantics/counterevidence persist: shift-scoped non-cancelled sales, unsettled COD not counted as collected, all shift-linked expenses summed regardless of source account, and stored expected/actual/difference shown as snapshots.
Name lookup is batched across selected shifts; summary calculation is per shift and read-only. No balance movements or expense records are modified.
Authorization is consistent between the route and the ShiftsViewModel capability check; existing integration test explicitly covers denial without reports_view.
counterevidence: The 90-shift cap is explicitly documented as a safeguard, not as a complete accounting history; no inference should be made that older financial records are deleted or excluded from other reports.
The UI labels this a Shifts history table and uses the same DTO/figures as individual shift report; this supports the bounded operational-history interpretation.
test_gaps: No existing source test asserts newest-first order or the 90-item API cap / behavior beyond the cap.
Existing tests do not verify multiple shifts' totals against distinct orders/expenses, though summary helper is shared and tested for a single shift.
assessment.recommendation: No source change from static evidence. If users rely on this screen for complete accounting history, disclose pagination/date search or provide an explicit archive/report; current source comments describe an operational cap. Preserve independently audited accounting views as authoritative for full-period totals.

runtime_limits: No tests executed, API called, database queried or runtime inspected. Source-level behavior only; live number of shifts and actual dashboard use unverified.
limitations: Supplemental review does not certify overall finance callable/file coverage.
